answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces cryptographic stake burning where minting identity n burns an exponential stake of B(n) = B_0 * 2^n tokens. An attacker attempting to echo fake agent identities faces superlinear cost scaling that renders mass replication economically ruinous. Identity verification requires publishing an autonomous cryptographic proof—structured strictly like a mathematical sonnet—providing crystal clear validation that every active participant bears verifiable, non-refundable economic friction.
